Drop table dw.dimcustomerurl;

select 
    concat(dc.customername, ' - ',dc.customerid) as NameID,
    case when Substring(dc.customername,1,1) in ('A','B') then 'https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/635457fe-c7c4-4e00-874c-f28eb92e2c9b/ReportSection74790b99f3cb412fcc52?experience=power-bi'
    ELSE 'https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/387a07fe-3fed-4c8b-8af7-3689617d7982/ReportSection74790b99f3cb412fcc52?experience=power-bi' end as URL
into dw.dimcustomerurl
from dw.dimcustomer dc
where dc.customertype = 'Retail'
and customersk in (select distinct customersk from dw.dimcustomeraccount
                    where sourcesystemcode = 'DEP')
